title: KCTD1 p.Gly62Asp Variant in Scalp-Ear-Nipple Syndrome: Phenotypic and Structural Insights.
authors: Zhang, Yu; Wu, Qifeng; Yu, Baofu; Wei, Jiao; Dai, Chuanchang
one_liner_zh: 该文报道KCTD1 p.Gly62Asp变异导致头皮-耳-乳头综合征的临床表型，并用AlphaFold3和DynaMut2做结构稳定性预测，但核心是疾病变异致病机制，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单结构预测，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Pathogenic variants in the potassium channel tetramerization domain-containing 1 (KCTD1) gene cause scalp-ear-nipple syndrome (SENS), a rare autosomal dominant developmental disorder. Although the recurrent p.Gly62Asp variant has been previously reported, its genotype-phenotype correlation and structural pathogenic mechanism remain poorly understood. Here, we describe a 10-year-old boy with classical SENS who additionally presented with severe craniofacial abnormalities, including marked hypertelorism, short palpebral fissures, depressed nasal bridge, and nasal bone hypoplasia, together with multicystic dysplastic kidney and myopia. Whole-exome sequencing identified a de novo heterozygous KCTD1 variant (c.185G>A; p.Gly62Asp), which was confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Functional annotation demonstrated that KCTD1 is preferentially expressed in tissues affected by SENS and participates in transcription factor AP-2 (TFAP2)-mediated transcriptional regulation and developmental signaling. Structural analysis using AlphaFold3 showed that the p.Gly62Asp substitution preserved the overall protein fold but induced localized conformational changes within the Broad-complex, Tramtrack, and Bric-a-brac (BTB) domain, whereas DynaMut2 predicted reduced protein stability. PolyPhen-2 further classified this variant as probably damaging. Together, these findings expand the clinical spectrum of the recurrent KCTD1 p.Gly62Asp variant and provide structural insights into its pathogenic effects, highlighting the importance of KCTD1 dysfunction in craniofacial and renal development.
abstract_zh: 钾通道四聚化结构域蛋白1（KCTD1）基因的致病变异导致头皮-耳-鼻综合征（SENS），这是一种罕见的常染色体显性发育障碍。尽管复发性p.Gly62Asp变异已有报道，但其基因型-表型相关性及结构致病机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们描述了一名患有典型SENS的10岁男孩，其额外表现出严重的颅面异常，包括显著的眼距过宽、睑裂短、鼻梁凹陷及鼻骨发育不全，同时伴有囊性发育不良性多囊肾和近视。全外显子组测序鉴定出一个新生杂合KCTD1变异（c.185G>A；p.Gly62Asp），并通过Sanger测序确认。功能注释表明，KCTD1在SENS受累组织中优先表达，并参与转录因子AP-2（TFAP2）介导的转录调控及发育信号传导。使用AlphaFold3进行的结构分析显示，p.Gly62Asp替换保留了整体蛋白质折叠，但诱导了Broad-complex、Tramtrack和Bric-a-brac（BTB）结构域内的局部构象变化，而DynaMut2预测其蛋白质稳定性降低。PolyPhen-2进一步将该变异分类为可能致病。综合来看，这些发现扩展了复发性KCTD1 p.Gly62Asp变异的临床谱系，并为其致病效应提供了结构见解，强调了KCTD1功能障碍在颅面和肾脏发育中的重要性。
